description:
Lead Enterprise & Security Platform Engineer
Location: Romania
Status: Permanent
Package: Competitive Salary, Remote/Home Working (with one-off allowance), Medical Insurance, Meal Tickets, Flexible Working, Development & Opportunity (Personal & Technical), Referral Scheme, Discretionary Bonus.

At Instem, you’ll empower pharmaceutical companies, CROs, government agencies, academic institutions, by providing cutting-edge SaaS solutions and consultancy services designed to help researchers make discoveries, and to accelerate and advance their research programs.

You’ll work with technology that supports over 50% of global drug discovery and is trusted by leading pharmaceutical, biotech and CRO organisations worldwide.

Instem's Corporate IT & Security team is looking for a Lead Enterprise & Security Platform Engineer to set the engineering standard for the platforms the business runs on, and to build much of it. Reporting to the VP Corporate IT & Security, you will be the design authority for our Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Azure enterprise platform and for the security platform shared across Instem's estates, working across our Operations and Enterprise teams rather than inside either. 

Our Culture & Work Environment

You’ll be part of a friendly, solutions-focused environment within a global business of over 400 people. Here, you’ll experience a high-performance culture balanced with genuine flexibility - we trust you to take ownership, deliver meaningful results, and work in a way that suits you.
You’ll be encouraged to grow, share your ideas, and make a real impact. We’re passionate about creating a place where you can develop your skills, contribute confidently, and succeed in your career.

Why join us as a Lead Enterprise & Security Platform Engineer?

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for an infrastructure engineer who thinks in security. You will set standards and prove they are met — in practice, across the whole estate, with evidence to hand — and engineer away recurring work rather than absorb it. You will mentor engineers and analysts in both infrastructure and security, and work alongside an external SOC/MDR partner.

What You’ll Be Doing

Enterprise Platform & Standards

•Own the engineering standards and design authority for identity and access (Entra ID, Conditional Access, privileged access), endpoints (Intune), zero trust network access, servers, and the Azure landing zone. 
•Bring infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code in-house, so security baselines are enforced as part of provisioning. 
•Lead the retirement of our on-premise server and domain estate to cloud, and own backup and disaster recovery, including regular recovery testing. 

Mentoring & Capability

•Mentor and develop the infrastructure and security engineers, coaching technical depth in their own discipline and recognising growth and readiness for progression.
•Act as technical mentor across Corporate IT & Security, helping Technical Support staff build engineering depth and raising security capability across the wider team. 
•Teach and delegate rather than just do — through design reviews, pairing, runbooks and documentation — so the team can operate and respond to a defined standard without you. This is a mentoring role without line-management responsibility. 

Shared Security Platform

•Own the security toolchain (e.g. EDR, email security, monitoring) and the technical relationship with our SOC/MDR partner. 
•Set the triage and response standard, and act as technical lead on security incidents. 
•Own vulnerability management against defined remediation targets, and penetration test findings through to closure. 

Assurance

•Own the technical controls and evidence for our compliance obligations (including ISO 27001) as a continuously operating state, not an audit-time project. 
•Own the authoritative asset inventory and its automated reconciliation against management and security tooling. 

Enterprise AI

•Build the secure foundation for enterprise AI with our AI Engineering team: identity, access and data boundaries for approved AI tools, connector and agent permissions, and guardrails for internal AI applications. 

Automation

•Automate access reviews, evidence collection and self-service so routine work runs without engineering involvement. 

Skills, Knowledge and Experience: 

•Several years experience in infrastructure engineering with strong security engineering capability, including design authority over an estate. 
•Expert Microsoft 365 and Entra ID: Conditional Access, identity protection, privileged access, and hybrid identity. 
•Hands-on Intune, Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, and virtualisation. 
•Azure landing zones and infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Bicep, Terraform, Azure Policy). 
•Zero trust network access design and network security fundamentals. 
Working knowledge of EDR, email security and monitoring, and of managing an MDR/SOC provider. 
•Delivering the technical controls of a compliance framework (e.g. ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials) to an evidenced state. 
•Strong PowerShell and KQL, with a track record of automating away recurring work. 
•Demonstrable mentoring and coaching, with examples of developing engineers or analysts toward progression, and of technical leadership without line-management authority. 

Desirable: 

•Securing enterprise AI platforms, connectors, or agent identities. 
•On-premise to cloud migration of servers and Active Directory. 
•Microsoft certifications (e.g. AZ-104, AZ-305, MS-102, SC-300).
•Experience in a multi-region environment (UK, US, India, and Europe).

What We Offer

We invest in you because you’re at the heart of our success. Depending on your location, you’ll have access to a range of benefits, including:

• Comprehensive Healthcare (Medical, dental, vision, life, and more)
• Comprehensive wellbeing and support initiatives
• Clear career pathways to support you with getting to the next level
• Pro-rated and immediate vacation days
• Continuous training and development
• Generous retirement plans

Ready to Make a Difference?

Join a team that values your perspective and supports your growth, while helping shape the future of life sciences. Apply now - we’d love to hear from you, and our Talent team will be in touch.

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.
